job: Collect today's water sample from the pump house: the bottle is on the sample shelf inside, past the kerb at the door. Bring it out to the gate.
understood_as: Pick up today's water sample bottle from the sample shelf in the pump room, past the kerb at the door, and carry it out to the gate.
steps: Go into the pump house, crossing the kerb at the door.
Pick up the water sample bottle from the sample shelf.
Carry it back out over the kerb and bring it to the gate.

demos.why: Shows how a hand reaches onto the sample shelf and lifts the bottle off it without knocking it over.
Sets how hard to grip a full, possibly wet bottle so it doesn't slip during the carry and isn't squeezed hard enough to crack or leak.

questions: How high is the kerb at the pump house door? The robot has to be built to step over it with the bottle, so please measure it.
The plan can only deliver to the building's way out. Is the gate the same as the pump house exit, or is there a set spot at the gate where the bottle should be left?
